research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Forcyte Biotechnologies is focused on developing therapeutic methods to address preterm labor by modulating uterine smooth muscle contractions. Their research involves the use of small molecules designed to relax these muscles, potentially reducing the strength, duration, or frequency of contractions in subjects requiring such treatment. This approach could offer a novel pathway for managing conditions associated with premature childbirth.

overview_description.description: Forcyte Biotechnologies, Inc. was formed to leverage FLECS Technology (originally developed in the Di Carlo Lab @ UCLA) to provide drug-makers and researchers direct access to cellular force generation at the single-cell level – a cellular behavior that was previously inaccessible in an automated way.Forcyte Biotechnologies provide a fundamentally new class of cell-based assays that functionally evaluate single-cell contractility, integrated into standard multi-wellplate vessels – available both as end-to-end services, and as consumables.

product.name: FLECS Platform
product.description: A high-throughput screening platform that quantifies mechanical forces generated by individual human cells using fluorescent micropatterns on elastomeric films.

product.name: FLECS Assay Well-Plate Products
product.description: Pre-fabricated assay plates compatible with the FLECS Platform for measuring cellular contractility in high-throughput screening.

product.name: Cardiac Tissuoid Assay
product.description: An assay that models coordinated contractile behavior of cardiac cells in a pseudo-3D format to study heart muscle function and drug effects.
